notes.title: A Fun Visual Novel
notes.notes:
Discover what SOFI (Sisters of Fashion and Influence) and Cindy are up to. Sometimes serious, sometimes fun, exotic, sexy or just relaxing.

It's the year 2048 and this visual novel is still being developed. The characters age slowly or not at all, are found in parallels worlds, at different ages, all that a movie can't do.
Possibly some Artificial Intelligence will create all the story and graphics.

Until then, we have to do with professional writers and amateur designers. :) We try so very hard, even with this free demo.

Thank you
